batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: st JM Sharma b KH Pandya

batting.name: R Parag
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b Yash Dayal

batting.name: SO Hetmyer
batting.dismissal: c D Padikkal b B Kumar

batting.name: PD Salt
batting.dismissal: c YBK Jaiswal b K Kartikeya

balls.text: Superb finish to the RR innings. Well done, Rana. Full and outside off, he is deep in the crease, clears his front leg and slices it over cover. RR finish on 173 for 4

Oh what a shot! But STRAIGHT TO deep midwicket. Bhuvneshwar just missed the yorker narrowly, Hetmyer seemed to have gotten under it. He flicked it away using all his wristpower but straight to Padikkal, who takes it despite the sun being in his eyes
Short and wide outside off, he slashes it over point
Banged in, pulled away! Bhuvneshwar goes pace on, and it sits up well for Jurel to go hard. Gets behind the line of it and pulls it over backward square leg
Knuckle ball away from him, 121.4kph, Hetmyer toes it in the air and it lands around the 30m circle, allowing them to take two
Full toss on leg, Jurel misses out. Hits it off the inner half to deep square leg
Another very full ball just outside off, manages to use his wrists to hit it down the track, even if not over the ground, 15 off the penultimate over
Full and wide outside off, he drills it straight down the ground. Timing if off, and that allows him two
Perfect yorker on the leg, Hettie manages to dig it out to the on side. He inside edges it onto the back leg
Length ball slanting away form him, lofted over wide mid-off, long-off gets around
Hacked away over midwicket now. Another length ball, this time from over the wicket, lands in on middle. Enough time for Jurel to go back and across and hack it across the line
Jurel picks the slower one and booms it out of his presence!. Bowls it full outside off, lands in the perfect slot for Jurel to wait and hit it straight over the sight-screen
Short and outside off, 118.1kph, Jurel moves across and mows it straight to deep midwicket. Not a bad over from Bhuvneshwar, 10 off it. Will he get one more?
Full and angling away, it seems to be the slower one, Hetmyer hits it off the inner half towards deep midwicket
Hetmyer power to the fore, thanks to Bhuvi's gift! Full toss on middle, he is still and heaves it away through midwicket
Full and outside off, he goes back and across to drill it down to long-on
The back of a length ball angled away from him, he can only slap it to long-off
Length ball down leg, he has a swing and misses. Called wide. He was eyeing the area over short fine leg
Short and outside off, he walks across and pulls it through square leg

Straight in and straight out! Kohli drops Jurel. Full outside off, he holes out straight to long-off, where Kohli fails to hang on. The bat turned in his hands. RCB's day on the field going from bad to worse, even if RR aren't flying away with this so far
Slogs it in the air and out of the ground! Finally Jurel connects one. Gets down on a knee and underneath the quicker legspinner to tonk it over the shorter side, into the deep midwicket stands
Quicker length ball on leg, it is the legspinner, he goes back and clips it through forward square leg for a brace
Full on off, driven down to long-off
Short and just outside off, it is the googly. It does not climb and Hettie plays it to the off side
Very full on leg, clears his front leg and knocks it down to long-on

Hits his pads and given! Hazlewood's celebrappeal helps but Jaiswal reviews it. It is a slower length ball from around the wicket, he gets across to swipe across the line but misses and is hit on the knee-roll. He is on his knee, so height perhaps won't be a concern. Three reds and that's that for Jaiswal. Timely strike for RCB with death overs looming
Length ball on middle, clipped through midwicket
Backs away but only manages to hit the full ball on off and middle to the left of backward point, where Dayal runs to but doesn't cleanly field it. No run conceded
Length ball slanting in from around, slapped through cover

And now a four through the off side, with Suyash diving over it. It was not off the middle. He backed away to a length ball outside off, looked to go over off but got a thick outside edge towards deep third, where Suyash made a hash of it
Scooped away in style! Jaiswal moves across to the off side, and gets the length delivery in his slot. He connects it and it goes the distance over fine leg. This is his best score this season
Spinning away from a length, chopped to point. Just six off the over, one through a leg-bye
Shortish on off, does not climb up as much as he expects, ends up getting it off the toe end through midwicket
Fired full on leg, he misses the sweep and has to rush to the other end. Jitesh's shy at the bowler's end is wide

The wrong'un on a length outside off, he goes across for a slog but misses. Goes off his back to the off side. Oh, another look tells me it went off his arm onto his helmet. No wonder the physio is out in the middle
Fuller on off, slogged to deep midwicket

Krunal cannot cut it off in the deep. Tossed up outside off, Jaiswal lofts it over cover. Slices it so that it takes it away from cover running to his right. He does so and dives but is unable to stop it
Dropped? Full and wide outside off, another slower one, Jaiswal goes hard at it. Chips it towards cover, where Livingstone dives to his right and parries it away
Length ball on off, he clips it to deep midwicket to get going
Slightly fuller, outside off, defended
Length ball just outside off, he taps it to the off side. Wants a run but there isn't one

What a wicket. Out of nowhere. The most undramatic soft dismissal. And Parag is out of here. Short and outside off from around the stumps, he looks to go over cover but hits it to short cover where Kohli crouches and takes it over his head. It was the back of the hand slower ball. Dayal dropped Parag earlier, now dismisses him to break a 55-run stand
Now Jaiswal is changing gears. Backs away and slices the full ball outside leg to deep cover-point

Superb effort at deep midwicket from Salt! Almost catches that. Times his leap to perfection to take it but he parries it back in, thinking he might go beyond the rope. Jaiswal found the length he wanted outside leg, and heaved it away to end Krunal's spell with a six. It almost went the distance but didn't. It almost ended his innings but didn't. It was the longer side
Smart, smart stuff from Jaiswal! Expects the line to be on the pad, sees a very full ball. He reaches out to take it on the full and paddles it very fine down leg
Fuller outside off, eased to cover, where the fielder misfields and concedes a run
Once again on the pad, whipped to deep midwicket
Darts it fuller than good length on leg, Parag backs away and eases it down to long-off
Shortish outside leg, he clips it through forward square leg to bring up his second half-century of IPL 2025
Quicker and just outside off, je looks to steer it fine but misses
Short on leg, clipped through midwicket
Quicker outside off, punched past extra cover
Fuller on leg, eased through midwicket. Put pressure on Livingstone, who does not gather it in a go
Quicker legspinner on off and middle, nudged through midwicket
Fires it well wide of off, he shapes to hit but leaves it be
Reverse hit, connected beautifully! This is full outside off, he quickly switches stance and 'sweeps' it between short third and backward point
Backs away to the length ball and slashes it to deep point, eight off Krunal's third
Turns it through midwicket to get to the other end
Fuller on middle and leg, once again stubbed out off the front foot
Stand and deliver! Some shot that. Lands it on a length on off and middle again, Parag stands still and hacks it away over deep midwicket. Key was in his weight transfer to the back foot
Flatter on off and middle, he bunts it down from the crease
Fuller outside off, pushed to cover
goes back in the crease and whips the ball against the turn to leg for one more
a poor long hop outside off, cut to point and Yash Dayal has put down a catch there! He jumped towards his right and the ball was not even outside his reach, should have taken that easily
and now through the keeper as Jaiswal misses the sweep outside off, and it goes through Jitesh's legs
on middle and some turn, punches it back to the bowler and he fumbles to leak a single
cut away on the off side, and that's raced for four! Didn't look like it would go all the way initially, but he timed it so well, a fierce cut off the back foot and he beat deep cover
starts with a googly on middle and leg, tucked to leg for one off the back foot
just a hint of room and that's all Parag needs to cut it away between point and short third for four!
quite slow on the middle stump, Parag waits and pushes to cover
low full toss this time and it's middled to long-off for one along the ground
no room to swing and he pushes the length ball back, Krunal dives to his right to save the single
on the pads and nudged square for one single
short and flat on the stumps, pulled back quickly to long-on for one
pushed to cover off the back foot and no time for a run
straighter now and it's whipped to the leg side for one
smashed back over LL for four! Too short, goes straight outside off, and Jaiswal had been showing signs of attacking earlier too. He slaps it back to beat long-off
loopy delivery on the pads, and he flicks the full toss away for one
offbreak outside off, Jaiswal swings it down to long-on
a legbreak for Parag outside leg, he stays back and then clips it behind square for one
straight bats the length ball from outside off down to long-off for one

misses it completely and he's gone! Samson will rue his luck because that kept quite low after pitching outside off, he ventured out a few miles for a big swing and missed it, stumped easily behind his back
straight on the stumps, no room and worked down to long-off for one
opens up for the off side but Krunal bowls towards the pads, and he nudges it to leg for one
really short and flat on the pads, swatted away to deep midwicket for one
starts outside off and Samson punches it to long-off for one
wide yorker now as point is deep at the rope, and Samson slices it away to that fielder for one
pulled just over mid-on! He makes room again, gets a short-ish delivery and middles that over mid-on
nearly in the block hole at 139.8kmh, Samson bunts it back to mid-off without much power
opens the face of the bat late to steer that to deep third for one
backs away early, Hazlewood follows him with the line and Samson gets some bat to mid-on for another quick single
lofts him straight back over the bowler's head, it's not going all the way, and luckily for Samson it lands just behind Tim David's reach after he ran back from mid-on
135.2kmh, pace for Samson who can't connect that shot-arm jab and takes a blow on the front pad, but the lbw appeal dies quickly
a half-hearted pull as Dayal goes shorter, there's a fielder in the deep so just one
crisp cover drive for the fuller ball, straight to cover this time
and a four to follow that behind the wicket! Shorter length, hint of room, and Jaiswal unleashes another cut, right how he wants it to beat short third for four

there comes the first six of the day! Really slow and pitched up, width as well, and Jaiswal gets the chance to free his arms and swing them for a loft down the ground. Straight six near the team umbrellas
swinging in from short of length, 135.7kmh, he defends to cover
ha makes room really early and the ball follows him, manages to pull it but doesn't clear midwicket
he gets bat on it this time, and taps the length ball on off to cover point
beats Samson this time! This is superb metronomic bowling from Hazlewood outside off. No movement to rely on, just on the spot that doesn't offer width
this time an appeal for lbw as Jaiswal cuts very close to his body, and that's another fine cut for one

an appeal for Hazlewood for caught behind as Jaiswal misses the cut this time. The umpire doesn't move and they don't take the review either. It was probably the sound of bat hitting the pad or the ground
just a hint of room outside off, Jaiswal goes back in the crease and cuts dangerously and the short third fine behind him can't get to it despite the dive. Not a bad ball but really good placement
nice and accurate on length outside off, no room, and he punches it back before Bhuvneshwar gets a hand to it. No runs
charges down and takes the ball on the full, but there's long-off in place so the attacking drive along the ground only gets him a single
keeps a little low outside off as Bhuvneshwar takes the pace off and it goes under the attempted cut
straight drive straight back and just beats the sliding mid-off fielder! Pitched up on middle stump, no swing, and he middled that right back
hardly any room for Jaiswal too, he tries to manufacture some but finds point with the cut
short of length outside off, Samson runs it down to deep third for one
again a boundary on the last ball! And it's Jaiswal this time too. Pitched up only slightly and Jaiwal swings his bat with the swing, towards wide long-on in the air for a one-bounce four
oh, a yorker with the new ball. And he nails it at the base of middle stump with some inswing. Lovely seam position to move it in, and Jaiswal did well to dig it out
slightly straighter and that's a crisp drive down to mid-off. Oh my, had mid-off sit the stumps at the bowler's end, Samson was gone!
edged and falls short! Samson drives again for the accurate delivery outside off, the thick edge flies behind and falls just short of the diving fielder at short third
marginally shorter around off, Samson hits it harder and uppishly and it's again stopped by short cover with a dive
pitched up first ball around off with some swing and Samson drives it straight to cover
dances down and smashes that back, Jaiswal breaks the early shackles with a boundary in the first over by beating mid-off
shorter and straight on off, Jaiswal taps it back and runs straightaway but he's sent back quickly
130.7kmh, on leg stump now, no room at all, and Jaiswal offers the straight bat to defend it back
131.6kmh, gentle and straight on the stumps, hardly any movement but Jaiswal gets an inside edge onto his pad
128.8kmh, lovely outswing well outside off, Samson sticks his bat out and gets a single towards point
starts on the leg side on short of length and Jaiswal tucks it off the hips for one, but off the thigh pad. So he's not off the mark yet

Easy does it! One of the most low-key winning runs. Length ball angling away from him, Padikkal reaches out to squeeze it past backward point. No one deep there and RCB seal a dominant nine-wicket win
Short and wide again with the slower one, punched aerially towards deep cover, where Jaiswal sprints forward and dives but it lands short
Short outside off, looked like the knuckle ball. Kohli pulls it through midwicket and charges back for two
Back of a length outside off, Kohli pulls it to deep midwicket, just nine off Archer's last over despite the boundary and the no-ball
Back of a length angling in from outside off, it gets big on him as he slaps it to deep cover-point
Perfect fast bowler's riposte! Angles in a perfect bouncer that floors DDP, who arches away to ramp it up
Angling in on a length, Padikkal clears his front leg and lofts it over midwicket. One, two skips and four.
Misses out on the full toss! Padikkal backs away to take full toll but only gets a thick outside edge on the bounce to Samson
Short and wide outside off, he hops and looks to slash it away and misses. Archer limps after bowling that. Called no-ball, he has overstepped
Full on leg, flicked through forward square leg

Dropped! Make that ninth for the game. It was not a tough one, really. Short and wide, it was the slower one. Padikkal looks to ramp it up and almost hits it down deep third's throat. Theekshana comes charging in and shells it after diving forward. 27 runs off the previous two overs
Short and outside off, he goes for the pull but misses
Picks the slower one now but doesn't get the desired result. Fuller in length outside off, he lofts it towards deep cover, where it lands short if Hetmyer charging in
Huggeeee! Short and angling into him, Padikkal has a free swing. Swivels and pulls it wayyyy over fine leg
Length ball outside off, chopped to backward point
Padikkal class in Jaipur. Holds his shape against the length ball and merely lofts it over the in-field. Over mid-off and four against Deshpande, who begins from around the stumps
Finds the gap to perfections. Maps or Kohli? Legspinner on a length on leg, enough time for him to go back and whip it away through midwicket
The wrong'un on a length on middle, punched to midwicket
Quicker length ball on leg, clipped through forward square leg
Glorious! Gets to a fifty in fine fashion Sees the flighted ball on middle, he dances down the track and smacks it straight over the bowler. His 100th T20 fifty, says Ian Bishop on air
Tossed up on a length on leg, clipped with the spin through square leg
Short on middle, he goes back and pulls it to deep midwicket on the bounce
Quicker length ball outside off, 99.9kph, punched to long-off
Length ball just outside off, punched back to the bowler
Slips in the quicker one on leg, he turns it to short fine leg and sprints to the other end
Length ball on off, punched through cover
Whipped away through midwicket! Seeing Kohli back away early, Theekshana followed him with a carrom ball. But it turned out to be a half-tracker that he heaves it away with ease
Quicker one on a length on leg, clipped through square leg
Goes over long-on! For a brief while, the fielder was interested. Tossed up full on middle, Kohli clears his front leg and thumps it straight over the fielder
Wristy on a length outside off, steers it to short third for a quick one
DDP misses out! Short and wide, the orthodox, he cuts it straight to backward point
Wrong'un full outside off, driven towards cover, where Archer dives and stops
Tossed up full on off, lofted towards long-off
Googly outside off, away from the batter, slapped to short cover
Misdirects again, pays the price this time. Quicker and down leg on a length, Padikkal goes back and only directs it fine. Easily beats short fine leg, ten off Parag's first
Angles it away from Kohli, 90.8kph, on a length, he slaps it past cover
Fired down leg, DDP misses his swish, Samson parries it towards short fine leg
Quicker on leg, turned through square leg. Looked like the arm ball
Skids on from a length, he goes back and pulls it to deep square leg
Lands it on a length around off, no pace on it, it spins away, DDP goes back and only pushes it back to the on side
Starts with a length ball on middle and leg, he goes back to punch it through midwicket
Fuller around off, 145.6kph, pushed towards mid-off for a quick single
Back of a length outside off, he stands tall and slaps it straight to short cover. It was at 142.9kph
Back of a length around off, he steers it to deep third to keep strike
Length ball on off, defended back down the track
Length ball well down leg, he flicks but misses
Almost chopped on. Archer cramps him up for room by coming around the wicket and bowling it on a length. He looks to glides it to third but gets an inside edge to the keeper
Length ball outside off, steered to deep third
Full and down leg, 127.4kph, Kohli makes way for it to fly to the keeper
on the pads again, a tad shorter, and he clips it square for one
on the pads now and worked to the leg side, another dot
stays low this time as it turns in towards middle, he defends it back
gets a leading off off the flick, it flies to the right of the bowler to long-off
and again too full, this time Padikkal leans into the ball and middles that beautiful cover drive to beat the sliding fielder in the deep
slightly short on leg, he goes back and clips to leg for one
on length outside off, driven past cover for one easily
short of length on middle, he pulls it away to leg for one

finally someone holds on to a catch and it's Jaiswal who had dropped Salt earlier! Not really a wicket-taking delivery, it's short again, Salt pulls again but this time finds deep midwicket as it had more height than distance
another short ball, another flat six on the leg side! It's just like the half tracker Hasaranga had bowled and it's the same treatment again, absolutely flat and wide of deep midwicket
slows it down outside off and Kohli slog sweeps with the turn to deep midwicket
full, quick and really wide outside off, it also goes off Samson's gloves and goes as two wides
103.2kmh, flat on leg and nudged to leg for one
better length on middle and leg with some turn, Salt waits and drives it back before it's stopped by the bowler
a half-tracker now and it's a flat six on the leg side! This is really poor bowling from their ace bowler. Too full earlier, now too short and it's pulled away with disdain
too full to Kohli as well, he happily drives it down as well
drives this one with hard hands down to long-off. One more
too full on off and that's whacked through the covers! Welcome back, Hasaranga! And it's a 28-ball fifty for Salt. A lot of bashing today while getting lives I've lost count of. Maybe two
accurate length delivery on the stumps, he punches it back
wristspin on middle stump, too full, and KK stops it after Kolhi drills it back
soft hands from Kohli to clip the ball square of the wicket and they get two more
short on leg now and swatted to deep midwicket for one
looked like he was bowled but he's not! Salt misses the wild heave as the ball pitches on off and goes straight and just misses the off stump! So lucky again, Salt
some room and Kohli bashes that back to long-off as well
full on middle first ball and driven down to long off for one
bangs the slower one into the pitch and Salt waits before pulling it away to deep midwicket for one

he knows exactly where those fielders are in the deep, gets a juicy full toss outside leg that's going for a wide, but he'd not going to let that one pass. Flicks it behind square on the leg side for an easy four
Kohli also comes down and he gets a single down to long-on

another drop! Smashed to cover where Jaiswal dives to his right and gets both hands to it while going low, and still puts it down. He could have dismissed Salt with a direct hit too, but didn't hit the stumps. And Sandeep wasn't interested in collecting the ball at all
dances down and smashes that over long-off for his fourth six! No fielder in the deep at long-off, he comes down to take the ball on the full and middles that straight drive down the ground
slow length ball on off, Kohli gently pushes it back to long-on
starts this fresh over with a wobble seam wide down leg
waits for the flatter delivery at nearly 105kmh, and collects a single to long on
dipping low full toss on leg, flicked down to long on for one more
full outside off now and he drills the drive to cover
over long-on this time and six! Short again, this one well outside off and Salt has the chance to free his arms. He opens up, pulls it right back with a horizontal bat and makes long-on a spectator
short on the pads and Salt unleashes a powerful swat right in the gap, behind square on the leg side for a cracking four
quite straight outside off, Kohli stays back and punches to long-on
drives that length one inside-out to cover, no time for a single
another tough chance and another one goes down! A leading edge off Salt's flick goes back towards the umpire, Sandeep sticks his right hand out and touches the ball too, but it goes down. So close!
swats against the line and doesn't quite middle it, finds mid on
on the stumps now and he flicks to deep midwicket for one
Kohli rubbing salt into RR's wounds now. Gets a length delivery outside off and unleashes a risk-free crisp cover drive that just about beats the chasing fielder for four

it's almost a wicket, but Riyan Parag has dropped it! Kohli came down first ball and skied that so high, it touched the moon and came back. And despite having all the time in the world, Parag gets under it straight down the ground and makes a mess of it. He had to cover some ground from long-on to his left but there was plenty of time
excellent sound off the bat even though it's a push to mid-off for one
he also swings on the leg side but doesn't really connect that
a wide yorker now on the other side, Salt slices it wide of cover for one

Hetmyer is a spectator this time, that goes all the way in the crowd! Length ball on the stumps, he is middling these balls now with pace on the bat and not as much swing as his last over, and it lands in someone's daal bati. Just kidding

middles that to deep midwicket and Hetmyer dives for the catch but can't hold on! That was a very tough chance after Salt swung it away, Hetmyer ran to his left and stuck his left hand out with a dive, nearly caught the ball too but it didn't stick in
can't even connect for the full toss! 137.2 kmh, he goes across for the swing on leg, gets a full toss below knee height and swings but miscues it to mid-on
flicked away over midwicket for his first four! On middle and leg, no movement really and he stands still and tall to chip that over the infield
swings for the near yorker on off and only gets an edge to leg for one more
comes down this time like Jaiswal was early in the innings, and only gets an edge onto his body while trying to punch it away
swinging in to Kohli as well, he tries to work it away but misses and the ball takes the pad on its way to the keeper
swinging in and Salt clips it to leg for one more
gets one outside off and drives through cover for one

very loud appeal for lbw and it's not given! Archer looked interested but Samson simply jogs from one end of the pitch to another as the over finishes, no review taken. That one swung in sharply from outside off, Salt moved to the off side again and missed the flick. Replays show that was umpire's call in front of off stump and the ball was hitting the stumps. So the review wouldn't have changed anything
Archer knows his team-mate as well! Another one swinging in, this time Salt doesn't move too much and takes another one on the pad
he probably knows his Sussex team-mate to well! Expects the bouncer and shuffles a long way to off early and hooks the bouncer, gets a top edge fine on the leg side for six!
142.3kmh, he reads the swing this time and gets bat this time to defend it to leg
sharp inswinger beats him again, barely any time to react and it thuds into his abdomen. No time to run anywhere for anything
beaten comprehensively first ball but that's gone for four! An unplayable inswinger after pitching around off, it cut Salt into half and went past the keeper for four, but off the edge
